column2: How do I change the order of the menu tabs, or add any list or tool to it?
column3: The “＋” at the end of the menu → “⠿ Menu order”: drag ⠿ (or reach ⠿ with Tab then press Alt + ↑ / ↓), the menu changes right away (“↶ Undo” in the message); it is the same order as in Settings → Menus. In “2 · A shortcut to a list” and “3 · A shortcut to a tool”, “＋ Another list…” and “＋ Another tool…” open the choice menu: search, tick one or more lines, “Add to the menu”. Your tabs go to the end of the menu (“Put my tabs at the end of the menu” box, ticked at first); an order you have already set does not move, and “⤓ Group my tabs at the end” brings them together whenever you want.
